entries.title: Philippians 2:1
segments: If [there is] therefore any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of [the] Spirit, if any tendernesses and mercies,

entries.title: Philippians 2:2
segments: then fulfill my joy, that you may be like-minded, having the same love, [being] of one accord and of one mind.

entries.title: Philippians 2:3
segments: [Let] nothing [be done] through strife or vainglory, but in lowliness of mind let each esteem others better than themselves.

entries.title: Philippians 2:4
segments: Do not let each man look upon his own things, but each man also [on] the things of others.

entries.title: Philippians 2:5
segments: For let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Philippians 2:6
segments: who, being in the form of God, thought [it] not robbery to be equal with God,

entries.title: Philippians 2:7
segments: but made Himself of no reputation, and took [upon Himself] the form of a servant, and was made in [the] likeness of men.

entries.title: Philippians 2:8
segments: And being found in fashion as a man, He humbled Himself [and] became obedient unto death, even [the] death of the cross.

entries.title: Philippians 2:9
segments: Therefore God has highly exalted Him, and has given Him a name [which is] above every name,

entries.title: Philippians 2:10
segments: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of heavenly ones, and of earthly ones, and of ones under [the] earth;

entries.title: Philippians 2:11
segments: and [that] every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ [is] Lord, to [the] glory of God [the] Father.

entries.title: Philippians 2:12
segments: Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, cultivate your own salvation with fear and trembling.

entries.title: Philippians 2:13
segments: For it is God who works in you both to will and to do of [His] good pleasure.

entries.title: Philippians 2:14
segments: Do all things without murmurings and disputings,

entries.title: Philippians 2:15
segments: so that you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation. Among these you shine as lights in the world,

entries.title: Philippians 2:16
segments: holding forth the word of life, so that I may rejoice with you in [the] day of Christ, that I have not run in vain nor labored in vain.

entries.title: Philippians 2:17
segments: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy and rejoice with you all.

entries.title: Philippians 2:18
segments: And you also rejoice [in] the same, and rejoice with me.

entries.title: Philippians 2:19
segments: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly to you, so that I also may be of good comfort when I know [your state].

entries.title: Philippians 2:20
segments: For I have no one who is like-minded, who will naturally care for [your state].

entries.title: Philippians 2:21
segments: For all seek their own, not the things which are of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 2:22
segments: But you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel.

entries.title: Philippians 2:23
segments: Therefore I hope to send him presently, as soon as I shall see the things about me.

entries.title: Philippians 2:24
segments: But I trust in [the] Lord that I myself shall also come shortly.

entries.title: Philippians 2:25
segments: Yet I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow-worker, and fellow-soldier, but your messenger and he who ministered to my wants.

entries.title: Philippians 2:26
segments: For he longed after you all and was full of heaviness, because you had heard that he had been sick.

entries.title: Philippians 2:27
segments: For indeed he was sick, coming near death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

entries.title: Philippians 2:28
segments: Therefore I sent him the more eagerly, so that you may rejoice when you see him again, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

entries.title: Philippians 2:29
segments: Therefore receive him in the Lord with all gladness, and hold such in honor,

entries.title: Philippians 2:30
segments: because for the work of Christ he was near death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
